label: Finding-50
title: versions-old: 'from 5 onwards' is wider than the finder's '_= 5.4', and the 5.x sources look like echoes of the leak
description: Wiz (X post and blog) says 5.4 and later. NCSC-NL's text is the pre-patch banner ('vermoedelijk ... in ieder geval vanaf versie 5'), CERT-FR lists 'toutes versions 6.x' (PHP 6 never shipped; Daubois says watchTowr named 5, 6, 7 and 8), and The Hacker News says the HN leak claimed 'from PHP 5 onward'. These trace to one origin (A3 at most). Suggest the claim say '5.4 onwards per Wiz; PHP's backports imply 7.4 onwards'.
